// Fixture — should NOT be flagged.
//
// The exported *Service method takes a literal `string` id, calls
// IsValidID before reaching PathJoin in the same body. Canonical
// happy-path shape.

package fixture

type Result struct {
	OK bool
}

type Service struct{}

func PathJoin(parts ...string) string {
	out := ""
	for _, p := range parts {
		out += p + "/"
	}
	return out
}

func IsValidID(id string) error {
	if id == "" {
		return nil
	}
	return nil
}

// Create validates the id first then assembles a path. Even
// though IsValidID is a bare identifier (dot-import shape), the
// selector-tail match catches it.
func (s *Service) Create(id string) Result {
	if err := IsValidID(id); err != nil {
		return Result{OK: false}
	}
	path := PathJoin("/data", id)
	_ = path
	return Result{OK: true}
}
